back: Reducing the size of a file to save storage and bandwidth.
Permanently removes some data; much smaller files; original cannot be rebuilt exactly.
Reduces file size without losing data; the original is rebuilt exactly.
Lossless: each run of identical consecutive values is stored as a count and one value (e.g. 6W).
Less storage, less bandwidth, faster transfer, smoother streaming, meet file size limits.
Reduce resolution or colour depth (images); reduce sample rate or resolution, remove inaudible sounds (sound).
Text, spreadsheets, program files, medical or legal images: data must be exact.
Data with few repeats: runs of length 1 double the data (two values per item).
Photos, music and video where a small quality loss is acceptable for much smaller files.
